items.text: Ask the group to tell the story from last week.

data.text: Read or watch Matthew 3:13-17 two times as others listen.

data.html:
The Baptism of Jesus

13Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.14But John tried to deter him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?”

15Jesus replied, “Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness.” Then John consented.

16As soon as Jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water. At that moment heaven was opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting on him.17And a voice from heaven said, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.”

items.text: What caught your attention or what did you like best? Why?
What is new or has developed at this point in Jesus story?
What do we learn about the humanity or divinity of Jesus from this passage?
How can we live differently now that we know this story?
What are his followers learning?
What is Jesus modeling to us about life and ministry or godly leadership?
Read the story again. Have someone tell the story and ask the group to correct if necessary.

data.text: Jesus travelled south to an area near Jericho, about 3-4 days journey from his home in Galilee. He may not have been sure of His next steps, but the Father led Him to be baptized by John. Baptism was used to identify a messenger and his message. {Luke 3:23} says he is about 30 years old when he began his ministry.
